scope: Repository implementation inventory. TESTED means associated automated tests exist and must be re-run; it is not production, authenticity or clean-machine certification. See qualification reports for actual outcomes.

capabilities.name: Scoped process observation
capabilities.purpose: Sample an authorized process tree and generation identities.
limitations: Process ancestry is not command causation. Sampling can miss short processes.
permissions: Explicit authorized PID and scope; no process termination
safety_boundaries: Evidence is data, never executable instruction. No private agent histories. No action authority from human review.
capabilities.version_compatibility: APM 0.2.0.dev1; development interfaces may change. Capsule v1 and Holmes journal schema 1 remain explicit contracts.
